**Distribution (run `cat /etc/os-release`):**
 
 Fedora 32, Gnome 3.36, Xorg
 
**Related Application and/or Package Version (run `apt policy pop-shell` or provide the latest commit if building locally):**

8ee8268f282b7951c2adf15992661c462450b875

Issue wasn't occuring with 0b31993db308d09dc4e8ab6ffb622ee849473715.

**Issue/Bug Description:**

Behaviour before:
![before](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39338488/79813676-4bc14f80-834a-11ea-8607-7fadc5879381.gif)

Behaviour currently:

![after](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39338488/79813690-5380f400-834a-11ea-97f9-a88dda3dffce.gif)

Active hint before was generated smoothly. Now an active hint box is generated during the transition as well.

**Steps to reproduce (if you know):**

Drag a window with the cursor somewhere else on the screen.
issue.title: Extra active hint box is created during moving windows with cursor

subject: fix: Hide active hint when window is moving

**Issue/Bug Description:**
Some Qt (possibly Qt5/Python) apps start as floating windows which cannot be tiled/docked and once run, all subsequent applicaiton loads (no matter the application) start in floating mode.
pop-shell then breaks with windows semi-tiled all over.

**Steps to reproduce (if you know):**

Simply run some samples from here: https://github.com/pyqt/examples

**Expected behavior:**

These python/qt5 apps should tile like any other and not break.


**Other Notes:**
issue.title: Qt WIndows start in floating mode and then break all tiling

subject: fix: Handle windows which lack a wm_class value

issue.body:
Could tiling on or off be shown in the tray icon, perhaps with active hint color as the background color of the icon?
I know this may sound a bit silly, who could not know that tiling is on, but it would however be a good fit for a toggle-tiling keyboard shortcut
issue.title: [Feature Request] Please show tiling on/off status in tray icon, preparation for tiling toggle keyboard short cut

subject: feat: Panel icon now indicates tiling mode
